original_question: Ted the T-Rex was planning to bring potato salad to the dinosaur picnic. He knows that an adult dinosaur will eat 10 lbs of potato salad, and a child will eat half as much as an adult. If there will be 20 adults and 5 children at the picnic, how many pounds of potato salad does Ted need to bring to the picnic if he hopes to have enough to feed everyone?
question_template: {name_dinosaur, Ted} the T-Rex was planning to bring potato salad to the dinosaur picnic. If there will be {num_digit_2, 20} adults and {num_digit_3, 5} children at the picnic, how many pounds of potato salad does {name_dinosaur, Ted} need to bring to the picnic if he hopes to have enough to feed everyone?
question_solution: answer = num_digit_1 * num_digit_2 + num_digit_1 * NUM(num_frac_1) * num_digit_3
conditions: int(answer) == num_digit_1 * num_digit_2 + num_digit_1 * NUM(num_frac_1) * num_digit_3
